topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by recapping the histopathology practicals and outlining the session's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and the development of assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define how cancer mutations are classified and demonstrate how specific genetic alterations disrupt tumor suppression and cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Genetic Instability and Multi-Step Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the molecular defects generating sequence and chromosomal instability and illustrate how progressive genetic defects drive tumor evolution.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations confer cancer predisposition and influence tumor development and evolution.
